title: Manifest
description: A manifest: the whole scope of one collection in one cheap read, each row carrying enough to choose a unit, and the unit carrying the rest. Named MANIFEST-<collection>.json, the collection being the identifier's name in full, so the file says what it is in a stream of output.

kind.description: the collection this manifest holds, the same word the file is named for, such as dossiers or orders; this is what chooses the schema

updated.description: the date the manifest was last brought level with its units, YYYY-MM-DD

convention.description: one line on how this collection is kept, for a reader who has never opened it

units.description: one row per unit, each with the unit's path and either its identifier or its name, plus whatever else is needed to choose between them

items.description: one row: a label, which is id for a collection filed by identifier and name for one filed by name, and then path to the unit — or, for a row whose unit never existed or has gone, superseded_by naming what replaced it

id.description: the unit's identifier, an abbreviation of one to three letters and three digits

name.description: the unit's name, for the collections filed by name rather than identifier: rosters and crew seats

title.description: one line saying what the unit is, enough to decide whether to open it

path.description: where the unit sits, relative to this manifest

status.description: where the unit stands, in whatever words the collection uses

superseded_by.description: the id or name of what replaced this one, for a row kept so the record is complete though there is no unit to open; stands in place of path
